label: LIVE_FORGE
method: Values read from Settings > Performance in this session (in-app timings, ms from app frame start) and from the host page Resource Timing API (ms from Jira page navigation start). Transcribed manually; the in-app JSON download was not used because browser downloads land outside the repository.
findings: Cold start to usable data is about 9.5 s (production) to 11 s (dev), not 20-30 s. Longer blank screens observed earlier coincided with the browser pane being hidden, which stops painting; treat them as a measurement artifact until reproduced in a visible tab.
About 2.2 s: Forge CDN delivers the Custom UI iframe document (1.8 s to 4.0 s after page start).
About 2.2 s: from iframe loaded to first resolver call (bundle parse, bridge init, token exchange).
About 2.6 to 3.8 s: getCapabilities then listProjects run sequentially; getCapabilities does no Jira call, so its 1.5 to 3.7 s is Forge invocation and cold-start overhead.
Warm: first content 51 ms, workspace connected 2.3 s.

EXPERIENCE: Issue getCapabilities and listProjects in parallel (saves about 0.5 to 1.7 s).
Render the shell and guided demo before capabilities return (already first content at 51 ms warm).
CORE: Consider merging capabilities into the listProjects response to remove one invocation round trip on start.
Keep resolver bundle small to limit cold start.
